Here is your curated Gold Coast events digest for the week of **11–17 May 2026**, based on thorough searches across your listed sources. I've skipped all spectator sport, corporate networking, MLM, and purely touristy events.

---

# 🗓️ Gold Coast Events Digest: 11–17 May 2026

---

## 🎵 CONCERT / MUSIC

---

### 1. 🔵 Blues on Broadbeach — Free Festival Program (4 Days)
**Dates:** Thu 14 May – Sun 17 May 2026
**Venue:** Broadbeach City Centre (19 stages across streets, parks & venues), Broadbeach
**Cost:** FREE (most programming); ticketed Sunday event available
**Category:** Concert / Music
**Source:** bluesonbroadbeach.com / experiencegoldcoast.com
**URL:** https://bluesonbroadbeach.com

Blues on Broadbeach is back for its 25th year, running 14–17 May 2026 — four days of live rhythm and blues on the Gold Coast. The Bamboos, Hussy Hicks, Mason Rack Band and The James Street Preachers are among the acts, with 19 stages popping up around the precinct — the biggest spread across Kurrawa and Victoria Park, plus restaurant and bar takeovers and ticketed events featuring Frank Sultana and Scottie Miller. The free program is genuinely community-scaled and draws a broad, music-loving crowd — the kind of festival where you'll naturally get talking to strangers.

---

### 2. 🎸 Blues on Broadbeach — Sunday Ticket (The Teskey Brothers)
**Date:** Sun 17 May 2026
**Venue:** Kurrawa Park, Broadbeach
**Cost:** Ticketed (approx. $124.20 incl. booking fee)
**Category:** Concert / Music
**Source:** bluesonbroadbeach.com
**URL:** https://bluesonbroadbeach.com/sunday-ticket/

The Kurrawa Park precinct will come alive on Sunday 17 May with Australian soul-soaked heavyweights The Teskey Brothers making their Blues on Broadbeach festival debut, joined by international Grammy-winning artist Judith Hill and Australia's dynamic string-bender Ash Grunwald. For the true blues enthusiast, the Twelve Bar Society membership immerses you in the ultimate festival experience — including exclusive access to a private VIP bar with up-close stage viewing gardens and 'In Conversation' artist sessions.

---

### 3. 💃 2000s + 2010s Party — Miami Marketta
**Date:** Sat 16 May 2026, 7:00 pm – 11:00 pm
**Venue:** Miami Marketta, 23 Hillcrest Parade, Miami (18+)
**Cost:** Ticketed (check Tixel/Humanitix)
**Category:** Concert / Music
**Source:** miamimarketta.com
**URL:** https://www.miamimarketta.com/ticketed-events/2000-2010-party

This event is on Saturday 16 May 2026 (7pm–11pm) at Miami Marketta — a 2000s + 2010s Party for those who want to dance to the best anthems from the era. A DJ night in one of the Gold Coast's most characterful creative laneway venues, with a warm, social crowd.

---

### 4. 🍺 Miami Marketta Street Food Night Market (Wed/Thu/Fri/Sat)
**Dates:** Wed 13, Thu 14, Fri 15, Sat 16 May 2026, from 5:00 pm
**Venue:** Miami Marketta, Miami
**Cost:** FREE entry
**Category:** Community / Other
**Source:** miamimarketta.com
**URL:** https://www.miamimarketta.com/night-market

Miami Marketta is a laneway dining experience with food vendors of all nationalities in one space, topped with free live music and boutique bars. There's something for everyone. From Wednesday to Saturday from 5pm, they open their doors for free — no bookings needed. Wander down the street food alley, catch some live music, and hang out with friends. Their midweek street food night also includes 15 global food vendors plus The Gin Parlour open to the public from 5pm. One of the Gold Coast's best recurring weekly social scenes.

---

### 5. 🎭 Life Drawing Sessions with Live Music — Miami Marketta Studio 56
**Recurring (check dates — typically midweek)**
**Venue:** Studio 56, Miami Marketta, Miami
**Cost:** Ticketed (check miamimarketta.com)
**Category:** Workshop / Class
**Source:** miamimarketta.com
**URL:** https://www.miamimarketta.com (check ticketed events page)

Miami Marketta hosts a curated evening of Life Drawing with Live Music in Studio 56. At Life Drawing Sessions the focus is not on the outcome of the drawing, rather the process of giving into the act of creating with music and muse — embracing people of all drawing levels from novice to maestro. Check the events page to confirm the exact date within this week.

### 6. 🎤 Ross Noble — Cranium of Curiosities
**Date:** Sat 16 May 2026
**Venue:** HOTA, Home of the Arts, 135 Bundall Rd, Surfers Paradise
**Cost:** Ticketed (check HOTA)
**Category:** Concert / Music (Comedy)
**Source:** allevents.in / hota.com.au
**URL:** https://hota.com.au

Ross Noble's *Cranium of Curiosities* is happening on Saturday 16 May 2026 at HOTA, Home of the Arts, Gold Coast. Noble is one of Australia's most beloved improvisational stand-up comedians, famous for his wildly digressive, genre-bending mind. An intellectually alive show with genuine surprise and creativity.

## 🎨 ARTS / EXHIBITION

---

### 9. 🏄 Flotsam Festival — Surf Photography & Film (Ongoing into This Week)
**Dates:** Running through May (see individual events)
**Venue:** Various — Coolangatta, Kirra, Currumbin, Burleigh Heads
**Cost:** Free and ticketed events
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Source:** theurbanlist.com / experiencegoldcoast.com
**URL:** https://www.whatsongoldcoast.au/All-events/Flotsam-Festival-6239070dbfe3c1a52f00844a

Flotsam Festival rolls through Coolangatta, Kirra, Currumbin and Burleigh Heads across 15 days, transforming the coastline into a living gallery of film, photography, exhibitions, music and creative events. Highlights include the International Masters of Surf Exhibition curated by renowned photographer Ted Grambeau, bringing together over 50 of the world's most influential surf photographers. The festival also includes a special screening and panel marking the 50th anniversary of Queensland's first feature surf film, *Tubular Swells*, and large-scale coastal installations. Some events may carry over into the start of this week (11–14 May). Check for any remaining screenings or exhibitions.

---

### 10. 🖼️ HOTA Gallery — White Rabbit Collection Exhibition (Ongoing)
**Dates:** Running since April 2026 through mid-August
**Venue:** HOTA Gallery, 135 Bundall Rd, Surfers Paradise
**Cost:** Free entry
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Source:** insidegoldcoast.com.au / hota.com.au
**URL:** https://hota.com.au

In April 2026, HOTA Gallery presented its next major exhibition drawn from the White Rabbit Collection in Sydney, one of the world's most significant and influential holdings of contemporary Chinese art. HOTA Gallery is open Saturday 7 March – Sunday 16 August, with free entry. A world-class contemporary art exhibition in the heart of the Gold Coast — and it's free.

## 🎭 COMMUNITY / SOCIAL / OTHER

### 11. 🔵 Life Drawing Sessions — Dust Temple, Currumbin
**Recurring (monthly — check dusttemple.com.au for May date)**
**Venue:** Dust Temple, 54 Currumbin Creek Rd, Currumbin Waters
**Cost:** Ticketed (check Humanitix via dusttemple.com.au)
**Category:** Workshop / Class
**Source:** dusttemple.com.au
**URL:** https://dusttemple.com.au

Life Drawing Sessions at Dust Temple has progressed into a night of sharing genuine creativity, with musicians performing live original music whilst the long-practised art of life drawing takes place. This event is open and welcome to people of all drawing levels — it's not just about the outcome of your drawing, but the whole process of giving into the act of creating with music and muse. Enjoy two and a half hours of untutored drawing with a life model and live music. Check their website to confirm the exact date this week.

### 12. 🧩 Gold Coast Board Games Club — Weekly Meetup
**Recurring (check meetup.com for exact date/venue this week)**

**Cost:** Free / low cost
**Category:** Social / Meetup

The Gold Coast Board Games Club is the place to go to have a blast playing modern board games with a great group of people. The group caters to people aged 18+. A recurring community of 630+ members that plays Catan, Carcassonne, Ticket to Ride, Dominion and many more. Perfect for natural conversation with curious, friendly people.

### 14. 🗣️ Gold Coast Social Work Expo 2026
**Date:** Thu 14 May 2026, 9:30 am – 1:00 pm
**Venue:** Varsity Lakes Community Resource Centre, Varsity Lakes
**Cost:** Free (check Eventbrite listing)
**Category:** Public Lecture / Community
**Source:** eventbrite.com.au
**URL:** https://www.eventbrite.com.au/e/gold-coast-social-work-expo-2026-tickets-1976690549645

The expo brings together social workers, students, community organisations, and allied-health providers to connect, learn, and showcase the depth of social work practice. It highlights real career pathways, community partnerships, and the many systems social workers work within — while also educating the public on what social work actually is. Join to network, discover opportunities, and deepen understanding of the profession's vital role in our community. Not a corporate event — this is a genuine community-focused gathering around human systems and social impact.

### 15. 🤝 Flying Solo Gold Coast — Social Group Events (Weekly)
**Recurring — various events this week**
**Venue:** Various Gold Coast locations
**Cost:** Free to join; some event costs apply
**Category:** Social / Meetup
**Source:** meetup.com
**URL:** https://www.meetup.com/goldcoasthiking/

This group runs beach walks, bushwalks and scenic hikes, monthly brunch meetups, monthly dinners at unique locations, road trips and weekends away, social nights including trivia and drag bingo, dancing and fitness events, theatre and concerts, and food and wine experiences. Membership is free to join; a $10 annual fee covers some exclusive events. Check their Meetup page for what's on this specific week — they run multiple events weekly.

### 16. 🎤 Comedy Underground — Weekly Saturday Night Comedy
**Date:** Sat 16 May 2026 (weekly)
**Venue:** HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
**Cost:** Ticketed (check HOTA / Based Comedy)
**Category:** Concert / Music (Comedy)
**Source:** basedcomedy.com.au / experiencegoldcoast.com
**URL:** https://basedcomedy.com.au/the-shows/comedy-underground.html

Comedy Underground is presented by Based Comedy and HOTA, Home of the Arts. Comedy Underground runs weekly on Saturdays. A recurring live comedy night at one of the Gold Coast's best cultural venues — great for discovering new voices and mixing with a lively, mixed-age crowd.
